Goa Tourism Development Corporation Ltd. (GTDC), Panaji is inviting applications for Manager (Marketing) on a regular basis.

📌 Vacancy: 01
📌 Category: Un-reserved
📌 Pay Matrix: Level 06
📌 Experience: Minimum 5 years, including at least 2 years in the tourism & hospitality sector
📌 Last Date: 21 October 2026

🎓 Eligibility: Degree + relevant postgraduate qualification in Management/Business Administration with specialisation in Marketing, along with computer and Konkani knowledge. Marathi is desirable.

📍 Applications must be submitted physically to the Managing Director, GTDC, Paryatan Bhawan, Patto, Panaji-Goa.

🔎 For complete eligibility and application details, visit www.dailyjobsgoa.in

💬 Comment “GTDC” for complete details.
